title: Whole Wheat Slider Buns
conciseInstructions: Activate Yeast: Whisk warm water (105°F), yeast, and honey. Rest 5–10 min until frothy.
Mix: Stir in flour, oil, and salt to form shaggy dough.
Knead: 8–10 min until smooth and elastic.
First Rise: Cover in greased bowl; let double in warm spot (60–90 min).
Shape: Divide into ~55g balls. Place 2" apart on parchment; press lightly to flatten.
Second Rise: Cover loosely, let rise 30–45 min. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Bake: Optional egg wash/sesame seeds. Bake 12–15 min until golden and hollow when tapped. Cool on rack.
notes: Exact baker's percentages noted for easy batch scaling.

title: Vanilla Cottage Cheese Waffles
conciseInstructions: Blend: Combine all ingredients in a blender; mix until completely smooth.
Cook: Pour batter into preheated, greased waffle iron. Cook ~3 min per waffle until golden.
Store & Reheat: Keeps well in airtight container in fridge. Pop in toaster for 1 min to reheat. Serve with berries.
notes: Family liked these! High-protein, meal-prep friendly.

title: Banana Chocolate Chip Waffles
conciseInstructions: Blend oats, bananas, eggs, vanilla, baking powder, salt, and extra peanut butter/yogurt until smooth.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Cook in greased waffle iron ~3–4 min until golden and set.
notes: Family liked these! Adding peanut butter and yogurt gives great moisture and extra protein.

title: Quick White Bean 'Cheese' Sauce
conciseInstructions: Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender.
Blend on high, slowly streaming in water until silky smooth and cheese-sauce consistency.
Warm gently on stove if serving over pasta or steamed veggies.
notes: Great nut-free, dairy-free cheese sauce base.

title: Curried Red Lentil & White Bean Dip
conciseInstructions: Simmer red lentils in water until very soft (10–12 min); drain excess water.
Add cooked lentils, white beans, tahini, seeds, lemon juice, garlic, and spices to food processor.
Stream in ice water while running until fluffy and ultra smooth. Season with salt.
notes: Loaded with micronutrients, healthy fats, and plant protein.

title: 5-Minute Soy Marinated Tofu
conciseInstructions: Whisk soy sauce, water, vinegar, maple syrup, sesame seeds, green onions, and chili flakes in a shallow container.
Submerge sliced tofu completely in the marinade.
Cover and chill for at least a few hours (or up to 4–5 days). Eat as-is cold or sear in a hot skillet.
notes: Great fridge staple. Can also swap in gochujang for a spicy Korean twist.

title: Slow Cooker Korean BBQ Meat + Skyr Gochujang Sauce

ingredients.item: Beef chuck roast, round steak, or pork shoulder

conciseInstructions: Mix soy sauce, 3 tbsp gochujang, mirin, honey, garlic, ginger, and black pepper; pour over meat in slow cooker.
Cook on Low for 6–8 hours until fork-tender and shreds easily.
Shred meat in juices; stir in finishing 4 tbsp oyster sauce and 2 tbsp sesame oil.
Whisk Skyr, gochujang, chili crisp, milk, and salt/pepper for the protein dipping sauce.
notes: High-protein meal prep powerhouse. Incredible served over rice or in lettuce wraps.

title: Crockpot Birria Tacos
conciseInstructions: Toast dried chiles in dry pan 1–2 min; boil in water 10 min to soften.
Broil or sear tomatoes, onion, and unpeeled garlic until charred; peel garlic.
Blend softened chiles, charred veggies, beef broth, vinegar, and all dry spices until completely smooth.
Place salted beef chunks and bay leaves in slow cooker; pour sauce through a strainer over beef.
Cook on Low 6–8 hours until falling apart. Shred beef; skim rendered fat from consommé for frying tortillas.
notes: Dip corn tortillas in surface chili fat, sear on griddle with beef, Oaxaca cheese, and fold.

title: Slow-Simmered Lamb, Potatoes & Cabbage
conciseInstructions: Combine lamb, potatoes, garlic head, cardamom, bay leaves, fish sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, touch of honey, and water barely covering.
Simmer covered on low heat for 1.5 hours until lamb is tender.
Add cabbage wedges; simmer additional 30 min until cabbage is meltingly soft.
Serve hot with a light drizzle of honey over top.
notes: Cardamom, fish sauce, and vinegar create deep umami balance with sweet cabbage.

title: Quick Ground Beef & Cabbage Skillet
conciseInstructions: Brown ground beef with onion, peppers, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and cajun seasoning in a large skillet; drain excess fat if needed.
Stir in tomato paste and tomato sauce.
Add chopped cabbage in batches. Cover and cook on medium-low for 10–12 min until cabbage wilts to desired tenderness.
notes: One-skillet staple meal prep. High volume, very filling.

title: Ultra-Rich Stout & Gelatin Beef Stew
conciseInstructions: Bloom gelatin in 1 cup cold stock. Whisk remaining hot stock with stout.
Make roux: Melt butter in Dutch oven, whisk in flour, cook 3–4 min until nutty; gradually whisk in stout/stock/gelatin until smooth.
Hard sear beef at 500°F (or brown deeply in batches); transfer into Dutch oven gravy with bay and thyme.
Cover and braise at 325°F for 1.5 hours.
Add potatoes, carrots, mushrooms, and pearl onions; braise 45–60 min more until fork tender.
Stir in frozen peas right at the end off-heat; season with fresh black pepper and salt.
notes: Gelatin packets mimic hours of marrow bone simmering, giving restaurant-glossy mouthfeel.

title: Turkish-Inspired Pomegranate Molasses Oven Stew

ingredients.item: Protein of choice (beef, lamb, chicken, or chickpeas)
Turkish pepper paste (biber salçası) or tomato paste

conciseInstructions: Whisk pomegranate molasses, pepper/tomato paste, olive oil, spices, and hot water in a bowl to create the aromatic broth.
Arrange meat, vegetables, and optional grains in a deep baking dish.
Pour broth evenly over everything.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 60–90 min until meat and vegetables are meltingly tender.
notes: Sweet-tart pomegranate molasses and Turkish pepper paste create an effortless signature flavor.

title: Tunisian Garbanzo Stew (Lablabi Style)
conciseInstructions: Simmer chickpeas in their liquid/water with generous cumin and salt until very soft.
Texture trick: Scoop out half the chickpeas and broth, blend until smooth, and stir back into pot for instant creamy body.
Make dressing: Whisk grated garlic, harissa, olive oil, and fresh lemon juice.
Stir the harissa-garlic dressing into the simmering pot.
Assemble: Tear crusty bread into bowls, ladle hot spiced chickpea broth over top, and garnish with extra harissa and capers.
notes: Blending half the chickpeas produces authentic rich texture without cream or flour.

title: Sufo (Greek Slow-Baked Chickpea & Vegetable Stew)
conciseInstructions: Drain soaked chickpeas, add fresh water, boil, and simmer 1 hour; drain.
In a heavy lidded Dutch oven, stir chickpeas with bay leaves, garlic, balsamic, honey, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Layer vegetables over top without mixing, starting with onions and tomatoes, then carrots, peppers, and eggplant.
Pour 1/2 cup olive oil over the top layer of vegetables.
Seal lid tightly (or foil seal) and bake at 350°F for 2.5 hours.
Serve warm with crumbled salty feta cheese and crusty bread.
notes: Classic clay-pot Greek baking method where vegetables steam-caramelize on top into the chickpeas below.

title: One-Pot Vegetable & Cheese Tortellini Soup
conciseInstructions: Sauté onion, carrots, celery, and mushrooms in olive oil 6–8 min until softened. Add garlic and seasonings 1 min.
Stir in tomato paste; cook 2 min. Deglaze pot with white wine, scraping bottom.
Pour in broth; bring to a simmer for 10 min.
Drop in tortellini; cook 3–5 min until al dente.
Finish: Stir in heavy cream, grated parmesan, and chopped kale until wilted. Season with salt and pepper.
notes: Very comforting and comes together fast in one pot.

title: Aromatic Pour-Over Peanut Miso Ramen

ingredients.item: Cooked ramen noodles, peeled carrot ribbons, blanched bok choy, chili oil, sesame seeds

conciseInstructions: Place grated garlic, ginger, scallions, miso, crushed dried mushrooms, chili flakes, and sugar in a heatproof bowl.
Heat oil until lightly smoking; pour directly over the aromatics to flash-fry and bloom flavors.
Transfer aromatic oil into blender with soy sauce, bouillon, peanut butter, and 5 cups boiling water. Blend on high 30 sec until frothy and emulsified.
Ladle velvety broth over bowls of cooked noodles and top with bok choy, carrot ribbons, and chili oil.
notes: Hot oil bloom + high-speed blending creates tonkotsu-like richness with zero animal fat.

title: Japanese Rice Cooker Chicken & Cream Stew
conciseInstructions: Cut chicken and season with salt, white pepper, and sake.
Chop onion, carrots, potatoes, and mushrooms; toss in bowl with 1 tbsp flour to coat.
Place veggies and chicken into rice cooker pot. Add garlic, kombu/MSG, butter, and 200ml water.
Start normal rice cooking cycle.
When cycle finishes, stir in 200ml milk mixed with 13g cornstarch and 0.5 tsp soy sauce. Let rest on 'Keep Warm' 5–10 min to thicken.
notes: Classic Japanese cream stew made effortlessly in a rice cooker.

title: Creamy Chicken, Mushroom & Arborio Rice Bowl
conciseInstructions: Season chicken chunks with 10g olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder. Sear on high 1 min per side; remove.
Sauté mushrooms with splash of water until dry (7 min); add 5g oil and stir-fry.
Add chopped onions with remaining 5g oil and pinch of salt; cook 3 min.
Add arborio rice and rosemary; toast 1 min. Pour in hot broth and return chicken.
Simmer covered on medium-low 20–25 min until rice is tender (check at 15m, add water if needed).
Off heat: Stir in 100g grated parmesan cheese. Distribute into 5 meal prep containers (refrigerate 5 days, freeze 3 months).
notes: 43g protein per serving! Reheats exceptionally well due to arborio rice starches.

title: High-Protein Cottage Cheese Lasagna

ingredients.item: Vegetables: Zucchini, carrots, red bell pepper, mushrooms, shallot, garlic
Seasoning: 5 tsp basil, 2.5 tsp oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper

conciseInstructions: Sauce: Simmer tomato sauce with dried herbs. Brown ground beef with garlic/onion; add to sauce. Sauté diced veggies until tender; fold into sauce.
Cheese Filling: Blend cottage cheese with cornstarch, eggs, dried parsley, 1 cup mozzarella, and 1/2 cup parm.
Assemble 9x13" dish: Sauce & cheese layer → noodles → sauce & cheese → noodles → sauce & cheese → remaining shredded mozzarella & parmigiano.
Bake: Cover tented foil at 400°F for 30 min. Uncover, bake 15 min. Turn to 450°F for 5–10 min until bubbly and browned. Cool 15 min.
notes: Up to 71g protein per slice! Cottage cheese replaces heavy ricotta with zero taste compromise.

title: Mediterranean Spiced Ground Beef Kebabs
conciseInstructions: Grate onion directly into beef so all onion juice is captured (crucial for tenderness).
Knead meat with garlic, parsley, and spices with hands for 3–4 min until mixture becomes tacky and emulsified.
Form long sausages around flat skewers or shape into oval patties.
Grill over direct high coals or broil 4–5 min per side until nicely charred outside and juicy inside.
notes: Serve with the Creamy Garlic Yogurt Sauce or Tangy Tahini Sauce below.

title: Creamy Garlic Greek Yogurt Sauce
conciseInstructions: Whisk yogurt, microplaned garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil in a bowl.
Fold in fresh herbs, salt, and pepper.
Chill 15 min for flavors to marry.
notes: The ultimate high-protein sauce for kebabs, roasted veggies, wraps, and bowls.

title: Tangy Lemon Garlic Tahini Sauce
conciseInstructions: Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and cumin. It will seize up and turn thick—this is normal.
Slowly whisk in ice-cold water tablespoon by tablespoon until it transforms into a pale, velvety pouring sauce.
Whisk in olive oil and salt.
notes: Essential companion to falafel, roasted sweet potatoes, and grilled meats.

title: 4-Ingredient Weeknight Meatloaf Ratio
conciseInstructions: Mix 1 lb meat, 1 egg, and 1/2 cup salsa gently until combined (salsa provides moisture and aromatics).
Form into a loaf on a parchment-lined baking sheet or loaf pan.
Brush tomato paste over the top as a glaze.
Bake at 375°F for 40–45 min until internal temperature hits 160°F.
notes: Salsa replaces onions, herbs, and breadcrumbs in one effortless step.

title: Almond Flour & Parmesan Broccoli Casserole
conciseInstructions: Whisk dry: Almond flour, tapioca starch, baking powder, salt, pepper.
Whisk wet: Almond milk, olive oil, eggs, dill, and grated parmesan.
Combine wet into dry; fold in broccoli florets and green onions.
Pour into greased baking dish and bake at 375°F for 45 min until golden brown and firm.
notes: High healthy fats and fiber with crispy parmesan crust.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken, Baby Potatoes & Pesto
conciseInstructions: Toss potatoes with 1 tsp oil, salt, pepper; roast at 425°F for 15 min.
Season chicken thighs with oil, salt, and pepper.
Push potatoes to one side; add chicken thighs and cherry tomatoes to sheet pan.
Roast 15–18 min more until chicken reaches 165°F.
Dollop pesto over hot chicken and potatoes right out of the oven and toss with fresh basil.
notes: Staggering potatoes first ensures everything finishes at peak crispness.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
conciseInstructions: Mix oil, chili powder, oregano, garlic/onion powder, cumin, salt, pepper, and cayenne.
Toss chicken, peppers, and onions in spice oil on sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 20 min until chicken is cooked through and edges char.
Squeeze fresh lime juice and scatter cilantro over pan.
notes: Serve straight from pan with warm tortillas, avocado, or salsa.

title: Sheet Pan Salmon, Broccoli & Sweet Potatoes
conciseInstructions: Roast sweet potato cubes with 1 tsp oil at 425°F for 10 min.
Toss broccoli with garlic, oil, za'atar, salt, and pepper; add to pan.
Place salmon fillets on pan, season with za'atar, top with lemon slices.
Roast 12–15 min until salmon flakes easily. Scatter feta over broccoli.
notes: Za'atar and feta pair remarkably well with roasted salmon and greens.

title: Sheet Pan Shrimp with Asparagus, Peppers & Couscous

ingredients.item: Crumbled feta, fresh dill, lemon wedges

conciseInstructions: Toss asparagus, peppers, and onions with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper. Roast 6 min at 425°F.
Toss shrimp with garlic, paprika, Italian herbs, and 1 tbsp oil. Add to sheet pan.
Roast 5–6 min until shrimp are pink and opaque.
Meanwhile steep couscous in boiling water/stock 5 min. Fluff and fold onto sheet pan with feta and dill.
notes: 30-minute weeknight dinner with minimal cleanup.

title: Sheet Pan Mushroom Basmati Rice with Chicken Thighs
conciseInstructions: Season chicken thighs with poultry seasoning, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
In a deep baking pan or sheet pan, scatter rinsed rice, mushrooms, onion, garlic, and butter pats.
Pour 1 cup boiling chicken stock over rice; nestle seasoned chicken thighs on top.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 30 min. Uncover for 5 min to crisp chicken skin/edges. Garnish with parsley.
notes: Rice cooks in the chicken drippings and stock right under the thighs.

title: High-Protein Cottage Cheese & Multi-Seed Bread
conciseInstructions: Blend cottage cheese and eggs until completely smooth.
In a bowl, mix almond/oat flour, baking powder, salt, and all seeds.
Fold wet mixture into dry ingredients until a thick batter forms.
Transfer to parchment-lined loaf pan. Sprinkle extra pumpkin seeds on top.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45–50 min until firm and golden. Cool completely before slicing.
notes: Incredible nutrient density: packed with healthy fats, fiber, and protein. Slices toast beautifully.

title: Smashed Edamame & Avocado High-Protein Toast
conciseInstructions: Pulse defrosted edamame, avocado, tahini, soy sauce, garlic, serrano, cilantro, sesame oil, lime juice, and zest in food processor until coarsely textured (not baby food).
Toast multigrain bread slices.
Smear generous edamame mash over toast.
Top with 1 tbsp hemp seeds per slice, flaky salt, and pickled onions.
notes: Far more protein than standard avocado toast, with vibrant umami from tahini and soy sauce.

title: Base Kansas City BBQ Sauce (+ Variations)

ingredients.item: Brown sugar, molasses, or Date Paste (1:1)

conciseInstructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.
Simmer on low for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool and store. (Flavors peak after 48 hours in the fridge).
VARIATION - Carolina Vinegar: 1.5c vinegar, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tsp red pepper flakes.
VARIATION - Alabama White: 1c mayo, 1/4c vinegar, 1 tbsp horseradish, 1/2 tsp black pepper.
SUGAR-FREE DATE PASTE: Puree 1 cup pitted dates with 1/2 cup hot water. Use 1:1 replacement for brown sugar.
notes: Pro-tip: Apply sugar-heavy sauces only during the final 10-15 minutes of grilling to avoid scorching.

title: Universal Sauce & Dressing Formula Matrix

ingredients.amount: Cashew / Tahini / Yogurt / Tofu / Miso / Sun-dried tomato
Garlic / Ginger / Scallion / Cilantro / Parsley / Basil
Honey / Maple / Dates / Gochujang / Chili flakes / Sriracha
Lime / Lemon / Rice vinegar / Apple cider vinegar
Olive oil / Sesame oil / Avocado oil / Water
Salt / Soy sauce / Nutritional yeast / Capers

conciseInstructions: Formula 1 (Creamy Cashew Cilantro): Cashews + Cilantro + Garlic + Cumin/Paprika + Lime + Avocado oil + Salt.
Formula 2 (Sun-Dried Herb): Sun-dried tomatoes + Parsley + Garlic + Honey + Lemon + Olive oil + Salt.
Formula 3 (Asian Miso Sesame): Miso + Ginger + Chili paste + Honey + Rice vinegar + Toasted sesame oil.
notes: Use this master ratio template to invent any dressing on the fly with whatever is in the pantry.

title: 8-Serving Peanut Salad Dressing

ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp red miso paste + 4 crushed dried oyster mushrooms

conciseInstructions: Whisk peanut butter, rice vinegar, soy sauce, honey, and lime juice until smooth.
Stir in minced ginger, garlic, sesame oil, chili flakes, and black pepper.
Add warm water 1 tbsp at a time to reach desired drizzling consistency.
notes: Incredible on crunchy cabbage salads, cold noodles, or grilled chicken skewers.

title: Silken Tofu Cream (Vegan Alfredo/Cream Base)
conciseInstructions: Drain water from silken tofu block.
Add tofu, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper to a blender.
Blend on high until silky smooth and glossy.
Toss directly with hot pasta for an instant healthy cream sauce.
notes: Replaces heavy cream in soups, pasta bakes, or casseroles with 100% plant protein.

title: Thai Date-Sweetened Peanut Dressing
conciseInstructions: Place dates, peanut butter, tamari, vinegar, lime juice, ginger, garlic, sriracha, and water in a blender.
Blend on high until dates are pulverized and dressing is smooth and creamy.
Adjust water for thicker dip or thinner salad dressing.
notes: Naturally sweetened with whole fruit dates. Excellent with spring rolls.

title: Miso Tahini Ginger Dressing
conciseInstructions: Microplane ginger and garlic.
Whisk with tahini, rice vinegar, miso, maple syrup, and tamari until smooth.
Thins easily with a tablespoon of warm water if desired.
notes: Complex umami profile that makes raw kale and shaved cabbage taste amazing.

title: Japanese Steakhouse Carrot Ginger Dressing
conciseInstructions: Chop carrots and place into high-speed blender.
Add ginger, olive oil, sesame oil, rice vinegar, miso, maple syrup, and lime juice.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until vibrant orange, emulsified, and smooth.
notes: Classic hibachi salad dressing, fresh and zesty.

title: Creamy Cashew Green Goddess Dressing
conciseInstructions: Drain soaked cashews.
Blend cashews, herbs, lemon juice, garlic, aminos, and water on high until glowing green and ultra-creamy.
Season with salt and pepper.
notes: Incredible dip for raw veggies, grain bowls, and grilled fish.

title: Creamy Nut-Free Sunflower Seed Dressing
conciseInstructions: Add sunflower seeds, garlic, miso, lemon juice, water, red pepper, and salt to blender.
Blend on high until silky smooth.
notes: 100% nut-free and dairy-free alternative to ranch or creamy Caesar.

title: Authentic Falafel Lemon Tahini Sauce
conciseInstructions: Whisk or blend lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and salt.
Add tahini; whisk until thick.
Whisk in ice water 2 tbsp at a time until sauce turns ivory white and silky.
notes: The authentic street-cart falafel sauce recipe.

title: Nut-Free Pumpkin Seed & Artichoke Pesto
conciseInstructions: Pulse pumpkin seeds and garlic in food processor until finely ground.
Add basil, spinach, tomato, artichoke hearts, lemon juice, and salt.
Process until thick and spreadable.
notes: Tomato and artichoke provide natural moisture so no added oil is required.

title: Smoky Chipotle Tahini Sauce
conciseInstructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high until silky smooth and deep red.
Taste for heat and adjust with an extra dash of maple syrup or lime juice.
notes: Bold, smoky, and zesty. Out of this world on burritos and roasted cauliflower.

title: Fresh Herb Oil-Free Dressing
conciseInstructions: Blend herbs, miso, lemon juice, mustard, sweetener, garlic, water, and salt until emulsified.
notes: Miso provides emulsion and body without needing oil.

title: Mint & Cilantro Greek Yogurt Sauce
conciseInstructions: Whisk yogurt, milk, grated garlic, herbs, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a small bowl until creamy.
notes: Refreshing cooling sauce for spicy curries, kebabs, and roasted vegetables.

title: Creamy Asian Tahini Dressing
conciseInstructions: Whisk all ingredients in a bowl or shake vigorously in a mason jar until smooth.
notes: Perfect balance of salty, sour, sweet, and nutty sesame.

title: Oil-Free Dill & Caper Dressing
conciseInstructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Pumpkin seeds and dates create a creamy emulsified texture without oil.
notes: Spectacular on potato salads, steamed greens, or baked tofu.

title: Citrus Orange Miso Dressing
conciseInstructions: Whisk orange juice, vinegar, miso, syrup, garlic, and ginger until blended. Stir in sesame seeds and pepper flakes.
notes: Light, bright, and oil-free.

title: Date-Sweetened Peanut Noodle Dressing
conciseInstructions: Blend peanut butter, rice vinegar, tamari, dates, lime juice, ginger, sriracha, and water in blender until creamy.
Toss with cold soba or ramen noodles, shredded cabbage, edamame, and cucumber.
notes: Whole-food sweetening with dates makes this far healthier than restaurant versions.

title: Korean Gochujang Ketchup
conciseInstructions: Whisk all ingredients in a small bowl until completely combined.
notes: Instant glaze for crispy chicken, roasted tofu, french fries, and burgers.

title: Japanese Restaurant Ginger Dressing (2 Variations)
conciseInstructions: Variation A: Whisk or blend all ingredients until emulsified.
Variation B: Blend apple, ginger, shallot, and seasonings in blender, slowly streaming in grapeseed oil until thick and creamy.
notes: The grated apple in Variation B creates the authentic texture of high-end Tokyo salad dressings.

title: Citrus Basil Dressing
conciseInstructions: Blend basil, orange juice, lime juice, Dijon mustard, avocado oil, salt, and pepper in a small blender until smooth.
notes: Vibrant emerald green dressing, especially delicious over grilled shrimp and summer greens.

title: Greek Chicken Souvlaki

ingredients.item: Skinless boneless chicken breast halves (cut bite-sized)

conciseInstructions: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and salt.
Toss chicken chunks in marinade. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours (or up to overnight).
Thread onto skewers; grill over high heat 4–5 min per side until nicely browned and 165°F inside.
notes: Classic Greek street food. Serve with warm pita, red onion, tomatoes, and tzatziki.

title: Raw Broccoli & Grape Salad (Cashew Date Dressing)
conciseInstructions: Blend soaked cashews, vinegar, garlic, dates, water, and pepper until silky.
Toss chopped raw broccoli, grapes, red onion, raisins, and almonds in a bowl.
Pour dressing over salad, toss thoroughly, and chill 30 min before serving.
notes: Sweet grapes and crunchy broccoli paired with tangy cream dressing.

title: Tomato, Artichoke & Garbanzo Salad
conciseInstructions: Blend lemon juice, vinegars, garlic, Dijon, and dates.
Combine tomatoes, chickpeas, artichokes, and fresh herbs in bowl.
Toss with dressing and chill.
notes: Fresh, bright, and naturally oil-free.

title: Curried Chickpea Salad Wrap

ingredients.item: Whole wheat lavash or lettuce wraps

conciseInstructions: Blend hemp hearts, water, vinegar, dates, garlic, Dijon, curry powder, and black pepper until creamy.
Mash chickpeas with a fork in a bowl, leaving some texture.
Fold dressing into mashed chickpeas. Roll in whole wheat lavash with crisp greens.
notes: Hemp hearts provide plant-based omega-3s and creaminess without mayo.

title: Smoky Tofu 'Elote' Street Corn Salad
conciseInstructions: Blend tofu, lemon juice, vinegar, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, chili powder, and salt until smooth.
Combine fire-roasted corn, jicama, cucumber, poblano, red onion, and cilantro.
Toss vegetables in the creamy spiced tofu crema.
notes: All the smoky magic of Mexican street corn with zero mayo or heavy cotija.

title: Cucumber Shrimp Salad with Creamy Lime Dill Dressing
conciseInstructions: Poach shrimp in salted boiling water 2–3 min; plunge in ice bath and pat dry.
Whisk mayo, sour cream/yogurt, lime zest, lime juice, dill, mustard, garlic, and salt.
In a large bowl, combine chilled shrimp, diced cucumber, and green onions.
Gently fold dressing into shrimp mixture; chill 20 min before serving.
notes: Crisp, refreshing, and loaded with lean protein.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea & Feta Salad

ingredients.item: Lemon vinaigrette (olive oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt)

conciseInstructions: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.
Dress with lemon vinaigrette and toss.
Gently fold in crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley so cheese stays in distinct bites.
notes: Keeps crisp in the fridge for up to 4 days.

title: Mango Curry Poached Chicken Salad
conciseInstructions: Whisk mayo/yogurt, lemon juice, curry powder, salt, and pepper.
In a bowl, combine shredded poached chicken, mango, celery, green onions, herbs, and cashews.
Toss with curry dressing until well coated.
notes: Juicy mango cubes and crunchy cashews complement the warm curry spices.

title: Plant-Based Firm Tofu Ricotta
conciseInstructions: Crumble firm tofu into a food processor or bowl.
Add minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, nutritional yeast, miso paste, herbs, and salt.
Pulse a few times until crumbly and fluffy like real whole-milk ricotta—do not over-blend into a paste.
notes: Use as a direct 1:1 substitute in lasagna, stuffed shells, or dolloped on pizza.

title: Greek Marinated Tofu 'Feta'
conciseInstructions: Whisk lemon juice, apple cider vinegar, miso, nutritional yeast, olive oil, garlic, oregano, dill, and onion powder in a jar.
Add tofu cubes to marinade, ensuring they are fully submerged.
Refrigerate overnight (minimum 12 hours) before serving.
notes: Vinegar + lemon + miso creates the signature salty tang of sheep's milk feta.

title: Crispy Maple Soy-Glazed Tofu

ingredients.item: Extra firm tofu (frozen then thawed for texture)

conciseInstructions: Freeze-Thaw Trick: Squeeze excess water from thawed tofu (ice crystals create meaty pockets). Cut into 1/4" thick squares.
Toss with 1 tbsp oil and 2 tbsp cornstarch.
Bake on sheet pan at 350°F for 20 min until golden and crisp.
Simmer sauce: Sauté garlic and ginger in 1 tbsp oil 1 min; stir in tamari and maple syrup; simmer 2 min until syrupy.
Toss baked crispy tofu directly in the hot sticky glaze.
notes: Freezing and thawing tofu transforms its internal sponge texture completely.

title: Crispy Grated BBQ Tofu Shreds

ingredients.item: Taco seasoning or BBQ spice rub

conciseInstructions: Shred the block of tofu using the large holes of a cheese grater.
Toss shreds with 1 tbsp oil, taco seasoning/BBQ rub, and salt.
Spread evenly on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake at 400°F for 20–25 min until edges are crispy and browned.
Toss hot shreds in BBQ sauce and serve on slider buns or grain bowls.
notes: Grating tofu creates hundreds of crispy edges that mimic pulled pork.

title: Crispy Shredded Tofu Tacos with Salsa Verde

ingredients.item: Firm tofu (patted dry & shredded on grater)
Soy sauce, cumin, paprika, chili powder

conciseInstructions: Toss grated tofu with soy sauce, oil, cumin, paprika. Spread on baking sheet; bake at 350°F for 30 min (stir once halfway).

Sauce: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft; add cumin, paprika, chili powder, and tomato paste; toast 2 min. Pour in pineapple juice and 1/2 tbsp soy sauce; simmer to a glaze. Stir in the baked tofu.
Salsa Verde: Blend cilantro, garlic, yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, cumin, agave, and salt until smooth.
Serve warm spiced tofu in charred corn tortillas with fresh veggies and salsa verde.
notes: Pineapple juice glaze creates authentic al pastor flavor depth.

title: Garlic Gochujang Tofu Marinade
conciseInstructions: Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, agave, sesame seeds, lime juice, and garlic.
Coat cubed tofu thoroughly; marinate 30 min or overnight.
Bake at 375°F for 20 min or sear in a nonstick skillet until glazed and caramelized.
notes: Korean spicy-sweet marinade that caramelizes beautifully.

title: Cumin Lime Tofu Marinade
conciseInstructions: Whisk lime juice, vinegar, maple, Dijon, cumin, garlic, cilantro, olive oil, and salt.
Toss tofu cubes in marinade; rest 30 min.
Bake at 375°F for 20 min or pan-fry.
notes: Zesty fajita-style tofu for burritos and taco bowls.

title: Blackened Jamaican Jerk Tofu Marinade
conciseInstructions: Add onion, scallions, garlic, ginger, habanero, lime juice, vinegar, soy sauce, syrup, allspice, thyme, bouillon, and water to blender; puree smooth.
Pour marinade over tofu cubes; marinate at least 1 hour.
Bake at 375°F for 25 min until blackened and charred along edges.
notes: Authentic Jamaican allspice and thyme flavor with habanero heat.

title: Maple Stone-Ground Mustard Tofu Marinade
conciseInstructions: Whisk vinegar, mustard, maple syrup, soy sauce, black pepper, cayenne, and salt.
Coat pressed tofu cubes and marinate 30 min.
Bake at 375°F for 20–25 min until sticky and caramelized.
notes: Tangy mustard glazes into a sweet-savory crust.

title: Lemon Caper & Thyme Tofu Marinade
conciseInstructions: Whisk shallot, lemon juice, olive oil, capers, caper brine, syrup, thyme, turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Coat tofu and marinate 30 min.
Bake at 375°F for 20–25 min until edges are golden and capers are crisped.
notes: Piccata-style flavor profile with briny capers.

title: Foolproof Quinoa Ratio & Residual Heat Technique
conciseInstructions: Bring water/broth and salt to a hard rolling boil in a pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Dump in rinsed quinoa.
Immediately turn OFF the stove burner and cover with the lid.
Leave pot sitting undisturbed on the hot residual burner for 20 minutes (do not peek!).
Remove lid and fluff with a fork.
notes: No burning, no sticking to the bottom, fluffy grains every single time.

title: 5-Minute Cashew 'Parmesan'
conciseInstructions: Place cashews, nutritional yeast, salt, and garlic powder into a food processor or small blender.
Pulse several times until it reaches the consistency of grated parmesan cheese (do not over-process into nut butter).
Store in a glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 months.
notes: Shelf-stable fridge staple. Shake over pastas, pizzas, and roasted veggies.

title: Blended Cocoa Milk Ice Cube 'Ice Cream'
conciseInstructions: Whisk milk, cocoa powder, and sweetener.
Pour into an ice cube tray and freeze solid.
Pop frozen cubes into a food processor; pulse and blend until smooth and soft-serve consistency.
Fold in chocolate chips without blending; serve immediately.
notes: Instant soft-serve texture without an ice cream maker.

title: Collagen Chocolate Freezer Cups
conciseInstructions: Blend nuts, collagen, cacao, oil, and sweetener in a food processor until smooth.
Spoon into silicone muffin cups.
Freeze for 10 minutes to set. Store in freezer for quick grab-and-go protein bites.
notes: Rich, fudge-like, and packs clean collagen protein.

title: Whole Wheat & Rolled Oats Muffins
conciseInstructions: Stir milk and lemon juice together; let sit 5 min to make quick buttermilk.
Whisk dry: Whole wheat flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, salt in a large bowl.
Whisk wet: Buttermilk, maple/honey, oil/butter, applesauce, egg. Stir wet into dry just until combined.
KEY REST STEP: Let batter rest 10–30 min before baking (lets bran absorb moisture and soften).
Spoon into muffin tin and bake at 400°F for 18–20 min until golden and toothpick comes out clean.
notes: The 10–30 minute rest prevents dry or dense whole wheat muffins.

title: 2-Ingredient Greek Yogurt High-Protein Pizza

ingredients.amount: 4 sticks (80g) — 60g in stuffed crust, 20g on top

conciseInstructions: Mix flour, Greek yogurt, baking powder, salt, and oil in a bowl until dough forms; knead 1 min.
Roll out on parchment into a round crust.
Stuffed Crust: Place string cheese pieces along outer perimeter, fold dough over cheese, press to seal.
Spread 60g sauce and remaining shredded mozzarella on center.
Bake at 420°F (220°C) for 15–20 min until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
notes: 41g protein per pizza! 1:1 ratio scales effortlessly for larger doughs.

title: 2-Day Cold Ferment Pizza Dough (Half Einkorn / Whole Wheat)
yield: 4 dough balls (~400g each, 2 meals per ball)
conciseInstructions: Combine warm water, instant yeast, and sugar; let sit 5–10 min until frothy.
Add milk, salt, olive oil, and flours. Mix at low speed 3–4 min, then medium speed 3–4 min until elastic and bounces back when poked.
Rest 10–20 min to relax gluten.
Divide into 4 balls (~400g each). Coat with oil, cover, and place in fridge for 2 days of cold fermentation.
Cook Day: Bring to room temp 1–2 hours before stretching. Leftover balls freeze exceptionally well after the 2-day ferment.
notes: Tested in kitchen: Half einkorn, half white flour with 2-day fridge ferment worked great! Freezes well.

title: Crispy Detroit-Style Pan Pizza (High Hydration)

ingredients.item: Wisconsin brick cheese or low-moisture mozzarella

conciseInstructions: Mix flour and yeast, pour in all water and combine. Add salt and oil; rest 1 hour at room temp.
Apply 2 stretch-and-folds at 15 min intervals. Letter fold to laminate. Rest in container 3 hours.
Divide into 2 balls; place in heavily oiled Detroit pans. Rest 3 hours, stretching with fingertips to corners like focaccia.
Par-bake dough naked at 525°F (275°C) for 10 minutes.
Top with cheese right up against the steel pan walls (for frico cheese crown) and stripes of warm sauce. Bake at 480°F for 15 minutes.
notes: 80% hydration produces airy honeycomb crumb and crispy cheesy crust walls.

title: Chicago Thin Crust Pizza (Precision Scaled Ratios)

ingredients.amount: Flour 100% | Water 55% | Gluten flour 3% | Salt 3% | Oil 2.5% | Sugar 1% | Yeast 0.9%
103g flour, 57g water, 3g gluten flour, 3g salt, 3g oil, 1g sugar, 1g instant yeast
155g flour, 85g water, 5g gluten flour, 5g salt, 4g oil, 2g sugar, 1g instant yeast
220g flour, 121g water, 7g gluten flour, 7g salt, 6g oil, 2g sugar, 2g instant yeast
284g flour, 156g water, 8.5g gluten flour, 8.5g salt, 7.1g oil, 2.8g sugar, 2.6g instant yeast

conciseInstructions: Knead ingredients into stiff dough ball.
Rise in airtight oiled container 24 hours at room temp, then 24–72 hours in fridge for maximum tavern flavor development.
Roll dough paper-thin with rolling pin, dock with fork or docker, cure on counter 30–60 min so skin dries slightly.
Bake at 500°F on preheated pizza stone/steel until cracker-crisp. Cut in tavern squares.
notes: Low 55% hydration + gluten flour produces authentic tavern-style cracker crust.

title: Classic Cold-Blended Pizza Sauce
conciseInstructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor.
Process until smooth.
Do NOT cook! Spread on pizza cold/room temp. Freezes exceptionally well in deli containers.
notes: Raw tomato blend cooks for the first time in the hot pizza oven, preserving sweet fresh tomato notes.

title: Andy Cooks 72-Hour Neapolitan Pizza Dough
conciseInstructions: Dissolve salt and yeast in water.
Pour into well in center of flour; bring together into shaggy dough.
Knead on clean bench 8–10 min until smooth and elastic.
Bulk ferment in warm room 6–10 hours until doubled.
Fold onto itself, divide into three 270g balls, roll tight using bench friction.
Store in airtight container in fridge for 24–72 hours. Remove 1 hour before stretching.
notes: Minimal yeast + long cold fermentation yields exceptional blistered crust and digestible gluten.

title: Japanese Low-Calorie High-Protein Chicken Simmer & Soft-Boiled Eggs
conciseInstructions: Season chicken breasts with 6g salt and 6g sugar. Boil broth ingredients; gently poach chicken on low simmer until just 165°F; remove and slice.
Soft-boil eggs (6 min in boiling water with 4 tsp vinegar and 2 tsp salt); shock in ice bath and peel.
Marinate peeled soft-boiled eggs in a cup of the simmer broth.
Thicken 200g of the remaining broth with cornstarch slurry into a shiny glaze. Drizzle over sliced chicken and halved eggs.
notes: Classic Japanese ramen-shop egg and chashu-style chicken breast meal prep.

title: Master High-Protein Overnight Oats Formula

ingredients.amount: 1 scoop whey powder or collagen peptides

ingredients.item: Flavor: Cinnamon, vanilla, cacao, maple syrup

conciseInstructions: Add oats, chia, whey/collagen, and spices into a mason jar.
Pour in soy milk or kefir; stir thoroughly.
Top with berries and nuts. Seal and refrigerate overnight.
notes: Core family staple breakfast. Custom flavor combos: PB & Cacao, Berry Kefir, Cinnamon Apple.

title: High-Fiber Protein Egg Wrap

ingredients.item: Sauce (Gochujang ketchup, Cholula, or garlic yogurt)

conciseInstructions: Scramble eggs with greens in hot skillet.
Warm wrap, fill with egg-green mixture, and drizzle with choice of sauce. Roll and eat.
notes: 3-minute staple breakfast.

title: Roasted Vegetable High-Protein Blender Soup

ingredients.item: Mixed roasting veggies (tomatoes, bell peppers, carrots, squash, onions, garlic)

ingredients.amount: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1 block silken tofu, or shredded chicken

conciseInstructions: Roast roughly chopped vegetables and garlic on a sheet pan at 400°F for 30 min until charred and tender.
Dump hot veggies into high-speed blender with hot broth.
Add silken tofu or Greek yogurt directly into blender for velvet-smooth creaminess and protein without dairy cream.
Blend on high 60 sec. Season with salt and pepper.
notes: The easiest way to consume 5+ vegetables and 25g protein in a single bowl.

title: Air Fryer Crispy Chicken Nuggets

ingredients.item: Large chicken breasts (cut into bite-sized nuggets)

conciseInstructions: Prep 3 bowls: (1) Flour, (2) Beaten eggs, (3) Panko mixed with parmesan, olive oil, and salt.
Dredge chicken: Dust in flour, shake off excess; dip in egg; press firmly into panko/parm mixture.
Arrange in single layer in greased air fryer basket; spray tops lightly with oil spray.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 12–15 min until golden brown and internal temp reaches 165°F.
notes: Mixing 1 tbsp olive oil directly into the panko ensures an ultra-crispy, deep-fried crunch without excess grease.

title: Slow Cooker / Oven High-Protein Beef Pasta Bake
conciseInstructions: Combine beef chunks, carrots, celery, onion, garlic, canned tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, wine/vinegar, and spices in a baking dish or slow cooker.
Cover tightly with foil or lid; slow cook at 300°F (150°C) for 4 hours until beef falls apart.
Shred beef directly in the rich vegetable-tomato sauce.
Stir in 160g cooked wholewheat pasta.
Top with 50g parmesan and 50g cheddar; return to oven uncovered for 10 min until bubbling and browned.
notes: High vegetable volume cooked down creates a thick, nutrient-dense ragù body.

title: One-Pan Thai Peanut Chicken Curry & Rice Bake
conciseInstructions: Scatter uncooked rice, diced chicken, zucchini, bell peppers, and broccoli evenly in a large ovenproof casserole dish.
Whisk red curry paste, coconut milk, peanut butter, and soy sauce until smooth.
Pour curry sauce over rice, chicken, and vegetables; stir gently so rice is submerged in liquid.
Scatter sesame seeds over top.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 40 min.
Remove foil and bake 15 min more until rice has absorbed liquid and chicken is tender.
notes: Rice cooks directly in the coconut milk and curry paste, soaking up all the aromatics in one pan.

title: Spanish Potaje de Garbanzos (Chickpea, Chard & Pork Belly Stew)

ingredients.item: Tocino ibérico (salted pork belly or pancetta)
Fresh Swiss chard (stems and leaves separated)
Choricero pepper paste or sweet pimentón paste
Pimentón de la Vera dulce & picante

conciseInstructions: Simmer soaked chickpeas with bay leaves, half garlic bulb, and tocino in water for 2.5–3 hours until meltingly soft.
Sofrito: Sauté onion, leek, and minced garlic in olive oil until golden. Stir in cumin and pimentón for 30 sec; add choricero paste, diced tomatoes, and white wine. Simmer into a thick paste.
Combine: Add cooked chickpeas, broth, and chopped chard stems into the sofrito pot; bring to a boil.
Finish: Fold in tender chard leaves and simmer 20–30 min. Season with salt. Rest overnight for maximum flavor.
notes: Separating chard stems to cook longer while wilting tender leaves at the end keeps greens vibrant.

title: Felu's 50g-Protein Chilled Pasta Salad

ingredients.item: Dry pasta (red lentil, chickpea, or Banza)
Lean deli chicken or turkey breast (cubed)

ingredients.amount: 0.25 tsp garlic powder + salt to taste

conciseInstructions: Boil pasta 2–3 min LONGER than package instructions (crucial for pasta salad so it doesn't turn chalky when chilled).
Place unthawed frozen edamame directly into serving bowl.
Drain boiling hot pasta and dump directly over frozen edamame (instantly thaws beans and cools pasta).
Whisk Skyr/yogurt, light mayo, olive oil, lime juice, garlic powder, and salt.
Toss diced veggies, lean poultry, and dressing into the pasta-edamame bowl. Eat fresh or meal prep for 3 days.
notes: Overcooking legume pasta by 2-3 minutes is the key secret to keeping it soft when refrigerated.

title: High-Protein Cheesy Bacon Mac & Pasta Bake
conciseInstructions: Combine boiled pasta, cheddar cheese, bacon pieces, almond milk, egg, Greek yogurt, and seasonings in a mixing bowl until cohesive.
Transfer into baking dish; cover with foil.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 25–30 minutes.
Uncover, scatter breadcrumbs over top, and bake 10 minutes more until top is golden and bubbling.
notes: Egg and Greek yogurt emulsify with cheddar into a rich cheese custard without needing heavy roux or cream.

title: 10-Minute High-Protein Chopped Grinder Sandwich

ingredients.item: Deli meats (turkey, lean ham, or chicken breast)
Crusty sub rolls or toasted ciabatta

conciseInstructions: Pile lettuce, deli meats, cheese, onion, tomatoes, and pickled peppers together on a large cutting board.
Drizzle mayo, vinegar, olive oil, and Italian seasoning directly over the pile.
Using a large chef's knife, rapidly chop and toss the entire pile repeatedly until ingredients are uniformly fine and dressed.
Scoop the flavorful chopped filling directly into toasted sub rolls.
notes: Chopping meats and veggies together with the dressing ensures every single bite has the perfect proportion of acid, fat, and protein.

title: Stealth Health High-Protein Freezer Meal Prep Pizza

ingredients.item: Garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper
ingredients.amount: 0.5 tsp garlic + 1 tsp onion + 0.5 tsp salt/pepper

conciseInstructions: Whisk flours, baking powder, and salt. Add Greek yogurt and 100g shredded mozzarella.
Knead 2–3 min on counter until a dense, tacky dough forms. Divide into 5 equal portions (~190g each).
Roll each dough ball into a thin 9" round crust.
Top with sauce, lean protein (turkey pepperoni or cooked lean turkey sausage), and light mozzarella.
To Freeze: Flash freeze assembled raw pizzas on baking sheets 2h, wrap in parchment/foil, and bag. Bake straight from frozen at 500°F for 14–16 min.
notes: Kneading shredded mozzarella directly into the yogurt dough provides gluten-like elasticity without proofing time.

title: Kenji's Foolproof No-Knead Cast Iron Pan Pizza

ingredients.item: Olive oil (for oiling cast iron skillets)

conciseInstructions: Combine flour, salt, yeast, water, and 8g olive oil in a bowl until no dry flour remains. Cover and let rise at room temp 8–24 hours.
Divide into 2 balls. Pour 2 tbsp olive oil into two 10" cast iron skillets; place dough balls in pans and turn to coat.
Press gently with fingertips toward edges; rest 2 hours until dough relaxes and fills pan completely with air bubbles.
Top with sauce and mozzarella right up against the cast iron edge for charred cheesy perimeter.
Bake at 550°F on bottom oven rack 12–15 min until top is bubbly. Check bottom; if needed, place pan over stovetop burner 1–2 min to crisp bottom crust.
notes: Zero kneading. The cast iron pan fried in olive oil produces an unbeatable focaccia-crisp bottom crust.

title: Cookwell High-Protein 3-Cheese Pizza
conciseInstructions: Combine bread flour, keto/gluten flour, yeast, salt, and warm water. Knead 5–6 min until elastic.
Let rise 1 hour until doubled; divide into two balls.
Stretch thin onto parchment. Spread 75g tomato sauce, torn fresh mozzarella, dollops of nonfat ricotta, and grated parm.
Bake at 500°F on preheated pizza steel for 8–10 min until crust is charred and cheeses are melted.
Brush crust edges with garlic melted butter right out of the oven.
notes: Keto flour or vital wheat gluten boost protein density without sacrificing dough handling.

title: Cookwell Grilled Chicken & Hummus Pita Pizza

ingredients.item: Fresh toppings: Shredded lettuce, diced tomato, pickled onions

conciseInstructions: Preheat sheet pan inside 450°F oven.
Spread red pepper hummus evenly over pita.
Top with shredded mozzarella and seasoned grilled chicken slices.
Slide pita directly onto the screaming-hot sheet pan in the oven.
Bake 5 minutes until cheese is bubbly and pita bottom is cracker-crisp. Top with fresh lettuce and pickled onions.
notes: 5-minute weeknight dinner using pantry staples.

title: Ethan Chlebowski No-Knead Sheet Pan Pizza
conciseInstructions: Whisk yeast with warm water and 1 tbsp of the flour; let foam 5 min.
Combine flour and salt in bowl; pour in yeast water and mix by hand into a sticky mass.
Work in olive oil until absorbed. Cover and bulk ferment 6–24 hours.
Heavily oil 13x9" pan with 2 tbsp oil; stretch dough to edges and rest 1 hour.
Top with crushed tomatoes and mozzarella; bake at 475°F for 18–20 min until bottom crust is deeply browned and crunchy.
notes: 75% hydration dough baked directly in an oiled rimmed pan produces Detroit-style focaccia crunch.

title: Ethan Chlebowski 2-Hour Weeknight Pizza
conciseInstructions: Mix flour, warm water, instant yeast, and salt into wet dough.
Drizzle olive oil over dough; perform 2 sets of stretch-and-folds in the bowl at 15 min intervals.
Cover and let rise in warm spot for 60 min until doubled.
Divide into two 360g dough balls; rest 20 min.
Stretch onto parchment or peel, top with crushed San Marzano tomatoes, garlic, chili, and mozzarella.
Bake at 550°F on preheated pizza steel for 8–10 min.
notes: 80% hydration + slightly higher yeast percentage develops full pizza structure in only 2 hours from scratch.

title: Charlie Anderson's Authentic New York Style Pizza
conciseInstructions: Whisk water, yeast, malt powder, and flours into shaggy mass; rest 20–30 min autolyse.
Add salt and olive oil; perform 3 sets of stretch-and-folds with 15 min rests until smooth.
Divide into two ~375g balls; place in oiled round containers.
Cold ferment in fridge for 48–72 hours.
Bake Day: Temper balls at room temp 2 hours. Stretch knuckles out to 15" with thin center and defined cornicione rim.
Slide onto 550°F preheated pizza steel; bake 6–8 min until blistered and foldable.
notes: Diastatic malt powder and whole wheat flour are the exact secrets home pizza makers use to get commercial deck-oven browning in standard home ovens.

title: Pro Home Cooks Overnight New York Pizza Dough
conciseInstructions: Combine flours, yeast, water, and salt; knead 8–10 min until smooth and passes windowpane test.
Bulk ferment in covered bowl 4–5 hours at room temperature.
Divide into ~250g balls; shape tight rounds and place in oiled containers.
Proof in refrigerator overnight (12–24h).
Bring to room temp 1 hour, stretch thin, top, and bake on preheated stone or steel at 550°F.
notes: Extremely low yeast amount (only 1g for 750g flour) gives complete enzymatic dough development without over-proofing.

title: JalalSamFit Creamy Garlic Steak & Rice Meal Prep

ingredients.item: Lean flank steak or sirloin (diced small)
Steak seasoning: Garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, pepper

conciseInstructions: Toss diced steak with seasonings and 1 tsp oil.
Sear in screaming hot skillet in batches for 3–4 min until browned outside and juicy inside (do not overcrowd).
Blend Greek yogurt, light mayo, garlic, lemon juice, parsley, and salt until smooth.
Assemble 4 meal prep containers: 100g cooked rice, seared steak, and drizzle of garlic protein sauce.
Refrigerates for 4 days.
notes: 54g protein per bowl! High-heat batch searing keeps lean steak tender without stewing in moisture.
